title: Arq to Attend Upcoming Investor Conferences
body_markdown:
GREENWOOD VILLAGE, Colo., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Arq, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARQ) (the “Company” or “Arq”), a producer of activated carbon and other environmentally efficient carbon products for use in purification and sustainable materials, today announced that Company management will attend the following upcoming investor conferences:


**Gabelli 4** **th** **Annual PFAS Symposium**


- Date: September 24, 2026
- Location: New York, NY
- Live presentation: 10am Eastern Standard Time
- For access, please register prior to the event via the following link:[https://gabelli.com/event/4th-annual-pfas-symposium/](https://gabelli.com/event/4th-annual-pfas-symposium/) .


**Water Tower Virtual Investor Conference**


- Date: September 23, 2026
- Location: Virtual
- Presentation time: 9am Eastern Standard Time
- To access Arq’s virtual presentation, please register prior to the event via the following link:[https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1770861&tp_key=bfed48f4a8](https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1770861&tp_key=bfed48f4a8) .


For interest in scheduling in-person New York meetings with the Arq management team the week of September 21, 2026, please contact[investors@arq.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=uoaisDPQSZnFvfBbhncH71RT-jZfU5XeVZGSOxzTVljQfVzpER3xiFNwpXZ2lfmDioA2WeESnekH0FIqTV_xMFJByNCTjzWj6iRl4QQF7FA=) . The presentation materials to be used by Arq management during these upcoming events will be made available prior to the events on Arq’s investor relations website at[https://ir.arq.com/](https://ir.arq.com/) .


**About Arq**


Arq (NASDAQ: ARQ) is a diversified, environmental technology company with products that enable a cleaner and safer planet while actively reducing our environmental impact. As the only vertically integrated producer of activated carbon products in North America, we deliver a reliable domestic supply of innovative, hard-to-source, high-demand products. We apply our extensive expertise to develop groundbreaking solutions to remove harmful chemicals and pollutants from water, land and air. Learn more at: www.arq.com.


Source: Arq, Inc.
